description:
Cast Stunt Double by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Stunt Double into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Stunt Double dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Stunt Double that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Stunt Double token instead.
